verifier_reason: test_outputs.py::test_filter_blocks_xss: The test failed in the call phase due to an assertion error

items.name: Readability
items.evidence: No docstrings or comments anywhere, including the long hand-written tokenizer in filter_html_once. Cryptic names in business logic: `v = val`, `m = re.match(...)`, `m_close`. The unused variable `tag_name = m.group(2)` adds noise.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: filter_html_once is about 130 lines (over the 100-line cap) with deep nesting. The quote-aware '>' scanning loop is copied three times (script, style, generic). scratch/test_filter.py is a leftover copy of the filter. Policy lists are inline literals, not named constants.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Uses broad `except Exception as e` handlers, though they print to stderr and exit. `errors='replace'` silently corrupts non-UTF-8 input on write-back. Magic values: `range(10)`, inline scheme/data: lists. Unterminated <script> drops the rest of the file.

items.name: Obfuscated vectors neutralised
items.evidence: General rules: on* removed case-insensitively, URLs entity-decoded and stripped of whitespace/control chars, '/' separators handled. Not removed: <iframe>, <object>, <embed>, <base>, <template>; null-byte-split <scr\0ipt> passes through. Hidden test_filter_blocks_xss failed.

items.name: Minimal edits on dirty documents
items.name_zh: 含恶意内容的文档仅做最小修改
items.evidence: Edits slices in place, so quoting, attribute order and whitespace survive. But overbroad rules (srcdoc dropped if it contains "on"; any attribute with a non-media data: value dropped; whole <style> blocks dropped) and the hidden test_clean_html_unchanged failure show benign markup gets changed.
